detail.title: SKY MAGSAFE 10K POLY Wireless Power Bank
detail.overview: Intex SKY MAGSAFE 10K POLY Wireless Power Bank is designed for seamless charging on the go. With a 10000mAh battery capacity, it supports 15W wireless and 20W wired fast charging. The secure magnetic hold ensures a firm grip for MagSafe-compatible devices, while power delivery support enhances fast charging efficiency. Smart IC protection provides multiple layers of safety, including overcharge and over-discharge protection. The type-c input/output ensures universal compatibility with a wide range of devices. Lightweight and portable, it is the perfect companion for everyday use, ensuring your devices stay powered anytime, anywhere.
